name: Pseudomorphine
summary: Pseudomorphine (also known as oxydimorphine or dehydromorphine) is an inactive, natural dimerisation product of the morphine molecule in tandem and thus a common impurity in morphine concentrations. It was first described by Pelletier in 1835.

pharmacology.en: It has little or no opioid activity.
pharmacology.zh: 它幾乎沒有鴉片類作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它几乎没有鸦片类作用。

uses.en: It has no medical use. It is mainly of interest as an impurity that is checked for in morphine products.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，主要是作為嗎啡製品中需要檢測的雜質而受到關注。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，主要是作为吗啡制品中需要检测的杂质而受到关注。

fact.en: Pseudomorphine is two morphine molecules joined together. It forms when morphine is oxidised, for example in old or poorly stored morphine solutions.
fact.zh: Pseudomorphine 是兩個嗎啡分子連在一起。它在嗎啡被氧化時形成，例如存放過久或保存不當的嗎啡溶液中就會出現。
fact.zhHans: Pseudomorphine 是两个吗啡分子连在一起。它在吗啡被氧化时形成，例如存放过久或保存不当的吗啡溶液中就会出现。
